reviews.text: Super clean environment, friendly staff! Each person truly cares for the animals individually and treats them like their own. Definitely a great home away from home for your pup

Very happy place for our doggo he gets to play all day with his friends and overnight boarding facility is available.
They take good care and also offer Webcam access to check on our pet..
Friendly & knowledgeable staff, my dogs love coming here!!
the staff is incredibly caring and treats each pup like their own!

Liberty Village is awesome.  They were so sweet and were able to help facilitate a reunion with my pup and her littermate.  Their facility is clean and staff very friendly and helpful.  Being able to see our dogs on camera during their stay is a plus!
Front desk staff are super friendly and welcoming, always keeping me up-to-date!

Our corgi Parsnip has been going to this location since 2024 and loves it! She is always excited, running in and demanding to be let through the doors by the rovers to be taken to "The Beach" room. We love the webcams to be able to see her activity there and the themed days and treats are so fun for all of us. Ruth is incredibly welcoming and greets every dog by name. Cherry and Mark are lovely to deal with too. I highly recommend this daycare over all the others in the area. They are consistent, they care about the dogs and provide a level of safety I can get behind.
Clean place and good staff

Always a great experience with Dogtopia Liberty Village! The staff are very friendly and welcoming, and always greet the pups by their names.
My dog has done daycare, boarding, and grooming here and we've been pleased with everything. We get report cards and photo updates so we know our dog is getting individual attention by staff, as well as playtime with the other dogs. There is also a live video feed so I can watch my dog making friends and playing!
Leaving my dog used to be really stressful, but Dogtopia does everything in their power to put my dog (and me!) at ease.
We will definitely be back soon!

I started sending my dog to Dogtopia this January, it was first difficult for him as he has never stayed in a daycare before and he is a shy dog that takes his own time to know people. And here everything was new and he was hesitant and scared to let me go. But the Dogtopia team was always so patient and friendly that helped my dog to adjust so well. Then after 2-3 months, he now loves the Dogtopia family so much. On Sunday walks also he will keep pushing me to go back to Dogtopia. One day on our walk, he saw a canine coaches and he was so excited to see the coach and started jumping and so truly happy to see the coach!! It was heartwarming to see the change in my dog.

My dog is a small Havanese dog and after I started sending him to Dogtopia, His reactivity towards other big dogs has also improved. He is no longer a picky eater. Dogtopia at liberty village has grooming and teeth cleaning services as well that makes it a breeze to get the grooming done while I am at work and evening I go pick him up and he is all clean and refreshed!

We love Dogtopia ❤️❤️

my pup ranger and i are obsessed with dogtopia !! he loves daycare and recently we had a last minute 2-night boarding stay for the first time, and they took such great care of him. they noticed he had an upset tummy and gave him pumpkin puree to help soothe it. they also noticed an abrasion on his paw he got a week ago and they applied balm on it. it’s clear they love the pups here and take such good care of each one !!
The perfect place to leave your dog. The team of dogtopia cares for the dogs with much love and makes sure each day is the best day ever!!
Took my cat here for a full spa/grooming service, the groomer handled him very well from start to finish and did a wonderful job! Will definitely be coming back :)

Great environment for the dogs! It's very clear that the dogs are well received and attended to because the dogs are always excited when going into daycare. Super convenient location since there are a lot of dog owners in Liberty Village too!
great communication from start to finiah and friendly well managed services. ask about their packages for longer stays
Great for playtime and also good grooming services.
amazing staff who care so much for the doggies couldn’t be happier to bring my dog here <3

Dogtopia Liberty Village is hand down, the best addition to our community for dog owners! Our puppy Olivia has loved this place from the minute she started going. She's made so many friends and loves each and every person who works there. When it's Dogtopia day, she can't get there fast enough.

The care and consideration they take for the dogs was truly unexpected and more than we were hoping for. SO grateful for the stress free and no worry experience they provide for daycare, boarding and grooming.

Love, love, love this place. There are SO many fun and unique activities they provide for the dogs as well as yummy treats.

If I could give them a 10 star Google review, I would!

Thank you Dogtopia LV!!

We can't say enough about the staff and quality of care our puppy has gotten at LV Dogtopia. We've had our dog in daycare with them and had her boarded as well and she's been super happy and well taken care of. 10/10!!!
The staff are experienced and always friendly, and my boy Greg loves getting pampered for his monthly spa day treatment from Victoria!

Edit: we also realized shortly after this grooming appointment, our dog needed another anal gland expressed. On the day of the appointment I told them on the phone and during pick up, they reassured me that they did complete the anal gland expressed. However, we noticed signed of her anal gland being full shortly after.

We loved coming here for get full grooms for our cockapoo. However in the last visit, we left super disappointed and felt blindsided.

We have been coming here since last year for regular grooms. However, there was no communication sent out to let owners know that there has been price changes or policy changes in regard to grooming.

We didn’t realize that having a curly coat, they charge $20 extra on top of what they charge for the grooming. Plus we have always been charged as a small breed, and suddenly they weighted her, and charge us as a medium.

These could have all been upfront at the beginning of our groom, but yet they chose not to. Even on their price list, they never mention anything with the charges with different coat. Won’t be returning.

We recently celebrated our dog Benny’s birthday at Dogtopia, and I can’t say enough great things about the experience. Cherry, Mark, and their entire team were incredible and made the day feel truly special from start to finish. Everything was seamless, well-organized, and stress-free.

A special thank you to Michelle, who supervised the dogs during the party—she was fantastic, attentive, and so helpful throughout.

Benny, along with our family and friends, had such an amazing time. We couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. We 100% recommend Dogtopia for anyone looking to host a fun and memorable birthday celebration for their dog.

Thank you, Dogtopia!

My dog Sonya absolutely loves coming here! She’s a bit shy but she gained a lot of confidence thanks to Dogtopia team! The staff is friendly and knowledgeable and you can see that they truly care for the dogs like their own. Would absolutely recommend bringing your pup here! ❤️
Amazing service!
Well organized facility! Amazing customer service! Over exceed my expectations!
Amazing all around! Staff and  facility is top notch in the city. Most of all, my dog loves coming here! Highly recommended!!
Very clean, great customer service! Would recommend any day!

Amazing dog daycare! The staff truly care about the dogs and make sure they’re safe, happy, and well taken care of.
You can tell they treat every dog like their own. Highly recommend!

I’ve had a really good experience with Dogtopia. My dog gets excited every time we get there, which says a lot. The staff are friendly and you can tell they care about the dogs. I also appreciate that the owner, Cherry is open to feedback and actually makes changes when needed. It doesn’t feel like things just get brushed off. I’ve used their boarding a few times as well and always felt comfortable leaving my dog there. Overall, it’s been a place I can trust.
My toy poodle loves coming here and they take such good care of him every time. We celebrated his birthday at dogtopia as well and it was the best experience!!!

Our puppy just graduated from the Puppy Kindergarten program. Andrea, the trainer, was great with our dog! After 6 weeks we were able to master the basic commands Sit, Stay, recall, leave it and started walking with a loose leash. It was a fun environment learning with the other dogs and their owners.
Professional and friendly staff. Great for doggy daycare, grooming and boarding!
My dear Sophie goes here for daycare amazing place thank you

I’m so grateful to have found this daycare in Liberty Village! My dog gets so excited as soon as we turn the corner. The staff is incredibly kind, attentive, and clearly loves what they do. I feel completely at ease knowing my pup is safe, happy, and well cared for every day
I love dogtopia because of the camera! Would recommend
Amazing atmosphere, and even better staff. my partners dog comes here and he always come home tired and happy.

Dogtopia of Liberty Village has provided the best environment for dogs of all shapes and sizes! Our dog has been taken good care of especially when they are boarding for a few nights. They send very frequent updates and are very responsive when you have questions regarding on your pup!  Let  your dog meet new friends!

Our dog Jetson absolutely loves Dogtopia Liberty Village, and so do we!

Our dog Jetson has been going to Dogtopia Liberty Village since November 2024 for daycare and boarding, and we couldn’t be happier with the care he receives. Over the past year we’ve used several of their services, and the experience has been consistently excellent. The team has created such a safe, welcoming, and well-run environment, and it’s clear how much they genuinely care about the dogs.

Jetty attends dog daycare at Dogtopia Liberty Village regularly and has also stayed for longer boarding visits, including a 16-day stay while our family was in Japan. Leaving your dog for that long can be stressful, but the team took incredible care of him and gave us complete peace of mind while we were away.

We also really appreciate the additional services they offer, including grooming, yummy treats, visits from the dog dental hygienist, and fun themed daycare days. Jetty gets so excited when we arrive and clearly loves spending time with his dog besties.

As a busy mom with a busy son, having a place we trust as much as Dogtopia Liberty Village makes a huge difference for our family.

A huge shout out to André, and to Jessica for the excellent service she provided while she was there, and to Cherry and Mark for creating such a thoughtful and caring place for dogs.

We’re incredibly grateful for the whole team. Jetson truly loves it there! 🐾

Mocha had the best time at Dogtopia! She’s not usually the most social and can be a little reactive, but she absolutely loved being there. The staff are incredibly knowledgeable and friendly, and they did such a great job making sure she had the best day ever. I felt so confident leaving her in their care highly recommend!
The space is very clean and well maintained. You can see that the staff genuinely care about the dogs and treat them with a lot of love and attention ♥️♥️ Everything feels organized and well managed

We've been bringing our small dog to Dogtopia for about a year and really enjoy the flexible booking process and that they separate the small and large dogs in different rooms. The staff are also always so pleasant and helpful.

Cooper is absolutely obsessed with coming to Dogtopia every week. He runs in the door so fast every morning because he can’t wait to spend the day with the other pups and humans. If I could give them more stars I would as I don’t know what I would do without the Dogtopia Liberty Village team!!!

Kai and Andre have made this experience so great! Since day one Andre is the reason I have chosen to continue to stay at Dogtopia! He takes care of my dog like she’s one of his own. The epitome of great customer service, please never leave!!!!!!!
Been taking boho here for almost 2 years and he loves it. Staff is super nice and space is clean!!
Lovely daycare service, Archer loves coming here! The staff have been so helpful and kind. The groomer here is also amazing!

Our dog has been visiting Dogtopia a couple of times a week for the last year or so and it’s been a great experience.   The staff are amazing with him and he loves all of the enrichment treats and activities - I think today he bobbed for fruit.
Cannot recommend Dogtopia of Liberty Village enough! Super friendly staff and they take great care of all the pups!! 🐶 …

My dog really enjoys the daycare — she gets so excited when we arrive! When she comes back home, she has zero energy (in the best way 🤣), which tells me she had a full day of fun and play.

I also love that they organize special treat days and little celebrations for the dogs. It shows how much they truly care.

I genuinely believe this experience has helped my dog become much more social and confident around other dogs.

We’ve been bringing our dog to Dogtopia since day one of rescuing her as a puppy, and we truly can’t say enough good things about this place. The team has been such a huge part of her journey — helping her grow, gain confidence, and make so many dog friends along the way.

Nova has come so far, and it’s clear how much care, patience, and love the staff put into what they do. She absolutely loves coming here and is always happy, excited, and wonderfully tired when we pick her up!

I originally planned to book somewhere else for my friend’s and my pups’ birthday, but they weren’t taking any party bookings because they were understaffed. That’s when I came across Dogtopia of Liberty Village through a Google search, and I’m so glad I did! Cherry (the owner) was so lovely and incredibly accommodating, and Michelle (the pet attendant) was amazing and helpful. Everyone had a blast! I can’t wait to host my other dog’s birthday here. I would highly recommend Dogtopia of Liberty Village to my friends and family!
The kindest staff, I trust them so much with my dog. They are always positive, timely and fun! So thankful to have this resource and amazing caretakers.
My pup Princesa loves coming to Dogtopia! She’s 14 years old and not the biggest fan of socializing, but here she finds fun, friends, and company since there are pups of all ages and energy levels.

Highly recommend this doggy daycare! The staff were incredibly kind, helpful, and supportive from the very start. We were just visiting Toronto for the day and didn’t want Athena and Chloe stuck in the Airbnb while we did activities they couldn’t join, so we decided to try this place and I’m so glad we did.

They made us feel comfortable right away and even have cameras, which really helped ease my anxiety. The facility is also very clean, which gave me extra peace of mind. Athena and Chloe had such a great time, got along well with the other pups, and came home happy (and very tired the next day, just like the staff said!). I also appreciated how informative they were throughout the process.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of my babies and giving them a fun, safe, and clean experience. We’ll definitely be back if we travel to Toronto again!
Lovely staff! Great programming. Our dog is always eager to play with the pack.
Nicest staff ever! Great experience! My dog Ellie loves Dogtopia!
My pup comes home from daycares exhausted! Loves the trainers! Loves his friends! Grooming option on Tuesdays and Thursdays make it very convenient!

We had such a wonderful experience with Dogtopia Liberty Village! Our dog had an amazing time during their stay—truly a vacation of their own. The staff were friendly, professional, and clearly passionate about dogs. We loved receiving regular updates. Our pup came home happy, well-exercised, and clearly loved every minute. Highly recommend Dogtopia Liberty Village for anyone looking for a safe and fun place for their dog to stay!
Dogtopia took such amazing care of our little Diego while we were visiting Toronto. Thank you to Jessica, Andre, and the entire Dogtopia staff! You all are amazing.

Hi Marco,

Thank you so much for the pawsome 5-star review! 🐾 We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience at Dogtopia of Liberty Village. It's always our goal to create a fun and safe environment for all our furry friends, and your feedback means the world to us. We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon!

Wags and woofs,
The Dogtopia Team

Took my dog for a grooming. The front staff were very pleasant and nice, seemed like a very great community atmosphere. Grooming job itself was done very well at a reasonable price.

Would recommend to others.

Amazing service! This location of Dogtopia was the bomb. They made our days possible by keeping our dog happy and safe. They even gave him a free nail grind just because they are so great. You can’t go wrong with this one.
Thank you for the rating Ahmed. We love having Kawaii here with us! She is a joy to have in daycare!
Amazing place and people, who will love your dog unconditionally.
Morris is an 11 year old Pointer and he LOVES going to Dogtopia. I thought it may be too much for him, but every time  I check in on him with the webcams he’s having a blast. The staff is also great.
Looking forward to providing your family more 5-Star experiences! :)
The best doggy daycare with the best staff! They have so many great events and they change each month.

🐶 Went for dog grooming
🐾 The staff is amazing!!!
🐩 Hair cut and bath was good
🐕 The bath for a big dog is the same price as Pet Valu BUT they charge as extra for higienic cut and nails so... Is going to be $90 bath + $45 (much more expensive than other places).

I would like to say thank u for all Dogtopia crew for caring/supporting Hazel Grace so nicely. She’s improve her behavior a lot, made a bffs and spent tons of energy playing and learning everyday more 🩷 we love to see our fur baby so happy 🩷 …
Thanks, Darshan!

Both our dogs had the best time at Dogtopia! The staff are so friendly and knowledgeable. Thank you for taking such good care of Gizmo and Twinkie for us, they are tuckered out!
See you again soon! 🐶 🐕❤️ 🐾 …

We're so grateful this opened! Fred love the staff (as do we) and his dog friends. He can be hesitant around bigger dogs (even though he's 50lbs himself), and we have seen such an improvement in his outside world confidence since going to dogtopia. The staff are kind and trained to help support your dogs so they have a great day!
Thanks, Jeff! Hope we get to see your two again soon :)
We appreciate the review! :)
So happy to have Dogtopia join Liberty Village!! My puppy Yeti loves going to daycare and the staff have been so nice there. Can't recommend enough!

I’ve been having a hard time trying to find a good grooming place in downtown Toronto,this place exceeded my expectations,I was able to find an appointment within a week,the place is very nice and the staff it’s extremely friendly,they did exactly what I asked for and took less than 2 hours(amazing for a Pomeranian with matting) the price is very fair for what you get,I’m very happy with the experience and I’ll be coming back 10/10

We LOVE Dogtopia Liberty Village! Staff are so kind + welcoming. They are incredibly professional. And our 2yr old Fox Red Labrador Retriever LOVES LOVES LOVES her new daycare! Would absolutely recommend Dogtopia Liberty Village for new dog parents in the neighbourhood.

My pup loves this place. The staff here are very professional and caring. They also play games with the pack so to keep them intellectually stimulated and it helps with obedience training overall. The setup with cameras, pickup, drop off just makes it so easy and keeps my mind at peace. I trust them wholeheartedly with my pup. And she’s always had a great time there!
Also, they do themed days with special treats so that your pup is always spoiled even when you’re not around!
